{{Youmay|the location on [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]]|the [[IG-227 Hailfire-class droid tank/Legends|IG-227 ''Hailfire''-class droid tank]], or other uses of the terms "[[Hell (disambiguation)|Hell]]" and "[[Fire (disambiguation)|fire]]"}}
{{Quote|Local name for Labor Valley's generators and fuel lines. Half of them are still burning from Republic sabotage and Imperial retaliation.|[[Deena Behar]]|<ref name="Factory Recall">{{TORcite|type=faction|Republic|Factory Recall|Corellia}}</ref>}}
'''Hellfire''' was a name given by the [[Corellian/Legends|Corellians]] to a complex of fuel lines and power generators located in the [[Labor Valley]] of [[Coronet City/Legends|Coronet City]]. During the [[Battle of Corellia]] in [[3640 BBY]] most of the generators were taken out during the intense fighting.
